map.按种类与生长阶段查询蛋白、脂肪需求，计算蛋脂比与可消化能: Look up the protein and fat requirement ratio of aquaculture feed by species and stage.
map.蛋白、脂肪需求参照 NRC 水产营养标准经验值；可消化能按蛋白 16.7 kJ/: Protein and fat requirements follow empirical values from the NRC aquaculture nutrition standards; digestible energy is calculated at 16.7 kJ/g for protein, 37.7 kJ/g for fat and 16.7 kJ/g for carbohydrate (estimated at 25%); protein-to-fat ratio = protein% / fat%.

map.多数温水性养殖鱼成体期蛋脂比在 4:1 ~ 6:1 较合理；苗种期偏重蛋白，育肥: For most warm-water farmed fish at the adult stage a ratio of 4:1 to 6:1 is reasonable; the fry and fingerling stages favour protein, while the fattening stage can raise fat somewhat, adjusted to the species and stage.
map.不是。脂肪供能高但过量会沉积肝脏导致脂肪肝，并影响饲料适口性与水质，须与蛋白匹配: No. Fat supplies much energy, but excess deposits in the liver causing fatty liver and affects feed palatability and water quality, so it must be matched to protein with an upper limit.
